description.en:
The category of the resource. Valid values:

- DataManagement

- Engine

- Monitor

description.zh:
资源分组。

当资源类别为DataManagement时，资源分组有：

- storage

- modelpipeline

- datastorage

- modeltrain

当资源类别为Engine时，资源分组有：

- feature

- predict

- recall

- recengine

当资源类别为Monitor时，资源分组有：

- logs

- logsback

- coldstart

- deploy
description.en:
The group of the resource.

If `Category` is `DataManagement`, valid values are:

- storage

- modelpipeline

- datastorage

- modeltrain

If `Category` is `Engine`, valid values are:

- feature

- predict

- recall

- recengine

If `Category` is `Monitor`, valid values are:

- logs

- logsback

- coldstart

- deploy
The instance ID. You can obtain the instance ID by calling the [ListInstances](~~2411819~~) operation.
